testcase.name: a name written without spaces is not learned as a joiner from one sighting
a cjk name and a cjk joiner of the same width are told apart by repetition
a mark joiner is believed the first time it is seen
a word joiner in any language is learned from seeing it twice
a phrase is never learned as a joiner however often it is seen
a repeated unlinked name is learned after the second sighting, and no sooner
